title: Legal Issues: Copyright, Trademarks and Privacy

flashcard_questions.q: Formal agreement from a property owner, individual or rights holder allowing a media producer to film, photograph or use content. Without permission, the producer may face legal action.
Making a false statement about someone that damages their reputation. Libel is written defamation; slander is spoken defamation.

Laws that protect individuals' personal information, giving them rights over how their data is collected, used, stored and shared. In the UK, data protection is governed by the Data Protection Act 2018 and UK GDPR.

flashcard_questions.a: Legal rights that protect creations of the mind, such as written works, music, images, designs, inventions and brand names. The main types are copyright, trademarks and patents.
A set of licences that allow creators to share their work with specific permissions, such as allowing reuse with attribution, non-commercial use only, or no modifications.
